title: Surgical Outcomes of Ab Interno Trabeculotomy Without Phacoemulsification

indication: mixed adult glaucoma (primary open-angle, exfoliation, steroid, chronic angle-closure, juvenile open-angle and other secondary glaucoma; neovascular glaucoma not treated with this procedure); standalone ab interno trabeculotomy with Tanito microhook or Kahook Dual Blade, without phacoemulsification (phakic and pseudophakic eyes); retrospective, first operated eye per patient, at least 6 months of follow-up

groups.description: All eyes after standalone ab interno trabeculotomy (microhook or KDB); only the whole cohort is tabulated over time (Table 2)

series.notes: mean ± SD; rows 'Preoperative', '1 month', '6 months', '12 months', '24 months', '36 months'; the number of eyes declines over follow-up (per-visit eye counts in Table 2 column 2, cells t0002!R3C2..R7C2); the article does not state whether IOP values after additional glaucoma surgery were removed from the later means

exclusions.reason: medication counts are mentioned in notes only (no medication series in schema 1.0.0)

exclusions.what: Tables 4 and 5 (t0004, t0005) Cox proportional hazards models
exclusions.reason: risk ratios and p-values, not IOP series

exclusions.what: Kaplan-Meier survival rates (Figure 2 and Results text)
exclusions.reason: Kaplan-Meier estimates and success proportions are not admissible

exclusions.what: Table 1 (t0001) preoperative IOP of the whole cohort
exclusions.reason: duplicate of the Table 2 preoperative row; the Table 2 cell is cited as the reference

exclusions.what: IOP of glaucoma subtypes or devices
exclusions.reason: not tabulated over time; only the whole cohort is available

notes: Reference: preoperative IOP tabulated together with the preoperative number of IOP-lowering medications (Tables 1 and 3), so recorded as preoperative_medicated; Methods state that previously used glaucoma eye drops were discontinued before the surgery without stating when relative to the preoperative IOP measurement.

27 eyes underwent additional glaucoma surgery during follow-up (Results); the article defines reoperation as failure for the Kaplan-Meier analysis but does not state a censoring rule for the mean IOP table. The number of eyes falls already at 6 months although inclusion required at least 6 months of follow-up; kept as attrition under the protocol because no outcome-defined exclusion is stated.
Table 3 tabulates the number of IOP-lowering medications at the same visits; not extracted.
Mixed glaucoma subtypes and two instruments (microhook or Kahook Dual Blade) are pooled in the tabulated series.
